artworks.title: Young Woman's Head
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's head and shoulders within a circular frame. The individual has straight, shoulder-length hair with a central parting, and is wearing a simple veil draped over their head and shoulders. The background is a plain, beige, and textured surface.

artworks.title: Wanaus, Tuscarora Indian
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on heavy ivory card stock
artworks.description: The sketch shows the upper half of two figures: a woman and a child. The woman is seated, holding the child in her lap. She has long, dark hair in a bun and a calm expression. The child, nestled in her arms, gazes to the side. Both are dressed in simple garments. The background is plain, and there is text in the bottom left corner identifying them as "Wanaus. Tuscarora Indian, Niagara September 1st, 1868."

artworks.title: Composition with Four Figures [recto and verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene with a group of individuals and a figure kneeling. The image is rendered in a loose style using washes of dark brown ink, creating a monochromatic effect. The composition includes a kneeling figure making a supplicating gesture towards a group of standing individuals. The background shows hills and a bridge, adding depth to the scene. The outlines of the figures are sketchy yet decisive, suggesting movement and interaction within a possibly historical or allegorical setting. The medium and style give the scene spontaneity and emotive power, encouraging contemplation of the narrative content.

artworks.title: Kentucky Fly-catching Warbler
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink with watercolor on wovepaper
artworks.description: The image shows two birds perched on a branch with a yellow flower in bloom nearby. One bird is labeled as male and the other as female. The birds exhibit green, yellow, and olive tones. The flower is positioned at the top of the branch. The male bird is on the left side facing right, while the female bird is on the right side facing left. The background is neutral, highlighting the vibrant colors of the birds and flower.

artworks.title: Gowanus Heights, Brooklyn
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink with brown wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a high horizon line, showcasing rolling terrain. There are faint outlines of buildings or a town in the distance. The artwork shows soft and delicate brushstrokes, possibly created with watercolor or pencil, without harsh outlines. The color scheme is sepia-toned, creating an antique atmosphere. Trees and rocks in the foreground frame the scene, leading the eye to more trees, a building, and open fields in the distance.

artworks.title: The Death of General Warren
artworks.medium: pen and ink over graphite
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals depicted from head to toe. One person is kneeling and supporting the other person who leans back against them. The kneeling person has short windswept hair and defined facial features, wearing a tunic with long sleeves and a skirt-like lower garment. The person being supported has closely cropped hair and a relaxed appearance, wearing a form-fitting outfit with visible creases and folds. They are seated on the ground with one leg extended forward and the other bent at the knee. The background is plain and unadorned, focusing on the two figures.

artworks.title: Riverhead, Long Island
artworks.medium: graphite with black crayon
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water in the foreground and a dense line of trees in the background. The trees form a silhouette against the sky. The horizon line is low, highlighting the sky and trees. The sky has swirling cloud patterns with dynamic pencil strokes. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of gray and black on a muted beige background. Closest to the viewer, strokes indicate vegetation along the water's edge.

artworks.title: Francois
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a young child in a full body view, positioned in profile to the right. The child's posture is slightly tilted forward with hands tucked into the pockets of her dress. Her facial features include a small nose and a slightly downturned mouth. The child's hair is short and curly, peeking out from beneath a broad-brimmed hat. She is wearing a long-sleeved dress with subtle vertical stripes, a large front pocket, and oversized shoes. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Rosetta, Egypt
artworks.medium: graphite and black crayon heightened with cream chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: The view is from a low angle, looking across a body of water towards distant land. The horizon is above the central part of the image. A grove of palms is on the horizon, separating the water from the sky. The brushstrokes are soft and atmospheric with blurred edges. The color scheme consists of warm earth tones and grays, with soft white highlights on the water and distant features.

artworks.title: Bible Lesson [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures interacting with books or texts. The scene contains lightly sketched figures gathered together, with some standing and others seated or kneeling. In the background are two large tablets with indistinct writing resembling the tablets of the Ten Commandments. The central figure holds a paper or scroll, while others are engaged in discussion or attentive listening. The fluid lines and subtle shading convey movement and interaction. The use of ink and wash gives the drawing a soft, flowing appearance, and the details suggest a scene of teaching or religious study.

artworks.title: Three Figures [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and ink
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bearded figure in robes and a nude figure. The first figure is dressed in robes with a gesture of movement. The other figure is nude with lines indicating movement or wind. The sketch seems unfinished, with detailed ink work on the robed figure and lighter pencil work on the other. Water stains and smudges give the piece an aged appearance. The style may be influenced by early modern European figurative art.

artworks.title: Allegory: Four Putti
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubs engaged in playful activities. The image shows three cherubic figures in different lively poses. One cherub is airborne holding up a framed portrait with tools bursting out. Another cherub is sitting and using a saw on a plank resting on a rock. The third cherub is lying down with arms spread, appearing to be either asleep or resting. They all have curly hair and youthful features. The background is simple, emphasizing the cherubs, and the drawing style is characterized by clear, confident lines resembling renaissance penmanship.

artworks.title: Banknote Studies [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite with touches of pen and brown ink on tan wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubic figures interacting with large circular objects. The drawing features a group of child-like figures, likely putti, depicted in various playful poses. The forms of the figures are outlined with delicate line work. The composition includes shading and texture for depth. Some figures are inside large circles while others are outside. The style is reminiscent of artists like Peter Paul Rubens. The figures are posed in ways that suggest movement and interaction, conveying innocence and playfulness. In the bottom right corner, there is a script indicating the place and date.

artworks.title: Studies of Classical Temple Facades and Seated Female Figure [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.description: This is a collection of conceptual sketches for architectural and decorative sculptures. The drawings include pencil depictions of classical figures in ornamental designs. The central sketch portrays a pedestal with four robed figures and a seated figure holding a staff on a cornice. In the top right, a solitary figure holds a spear. Above the central scene, there is an outline of figures under an arch, possibly part of a frieze or mural. The drawings emphasize symmetry and balance, typical of classical architectural decoration. The paper's texture and delicate lines suggest an aged appearance.

artworks.title: H. Wood Sullivan - "The Shaver"
artworks.medium: graphite on aged brown sulphured wove paper; verso blackened for transfer
artworks.description: An elderly man is seated on a wooden chair, facing to the left. He has short, wispy hair and is holding a razor. He wears a shirt with rolled-up sleeves and suspenders. There is a table in front of him with a booklet, a mug, and a box. The room has wooden paneling on the walls, a large door, and a small framed picture on the wall.

artworks.title: On the Road from Conway
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an ink sketch of a mountainous landscape from a slightly elevated viewpoint. There are hills, trees, a house, and a path in the foreground, leading to a valley surrounded by mountains in the background. The sketch is done in black ink on sepia-toned paper, with simple and flowing lines defining the scene.

artworks.title: Temples of Juno, Lucina, and Concordia - Agrigentum, Sicily
artworks.medium: graphite with white gouache on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a rugged landscape with a low horizon. The sky occupies the upper two-thirds of the image. Two ancient columns, partially broken and weathered, are on a rocky outcrop to the right. Loose and sketch-like brushstrokes depict outlines and shades. The color palette is subdued, mainly soft earth tones and beige. In the distance, an ancient temple-like structure can be seen, adding depth to the composition. The rocks and vegetation cascading down the slope are depicted with light and dark contrasts.

artworks.title: The Bridge of Fear
artworks.medium: graphite and black crayon with gray wash on wove paper

artworks.title: The Good Shepherd
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and ink with tan and gray wash, heightened with white, on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a landscape viewed from an elevated vantage point. A rocky outcrop with scattered stones is at the bottom, with a shepherd holding a long crook and tending a sheep on the right side. The horizon is behind rolling hills and distant mountains, and there is a wide, flat field lined with trees between the rocky ground near us and the distant hills. The sky above has soft white clouds. The drawing is done in gray on top of beige paper with some white highlights.

artworks.title: Lullaby
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and white wash on graypaper-surfaced cardboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated, holding an infant in her arms. Both figures are visible from the shoulders down. The woman is in a side profile, leaning over the child in a nurturing position. She has dark hair styled in an updo and is wearing a long gown with voluminous sleeves and a ruffled collar. The woman sits on a chair, with her feet on a cushioned footstool. The infant is dressed in a gown as well. In the background, a window with curtains drawn to the side reveals foliage outside, allowing light into the room. A side table with an object on it is nearby.

artworks.title: A Corner Window, Will Low
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man from the waist up, positioned sideways with his left arm resting on a chair or railing and his right hand near his face. He has a mustache and short hair, styled neatly. The man is dressed in a buttoned-up collared shirt. Surrounding him are various objects, including a glass and several vases on the window ledge behind him. The walls are adorned with a few portraits or photographs. The background features a window partially covered with a fringe-like decoration, allowing light to illuminate the scene.

artworks.title: Seated Male Nude: Study for "Science" - Iowa State Capitol
artworks.medium: graphite pencil, squared in graphite, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a detailed sketch of a seated male figure. The man is resting his head on his right hand and his left arm is bent, resting on his knee. His head is tilted downwards, and he appears to be in a thoughtful pose. The man has defined facial features, a muscular build, short hair, and is depicted without clothing. The sketch emphasizes the contours and shadows of the body through precise linework. The background features a faint grid layout, possibly a drawing aid. At the bottom left, the artist's signature and the year 1907 are visible.

artworks.title: Reclining Female Nude Study for "Painting"
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper, squared with graphite
artworks.description: The image is a drawing depicting the full body of a nude person seated against a cushion or draped fabric. The person has long, flowing hair adorned with a wreath of flowers. They have subtle facial features with soft shading defining their eyes and lips. The individual is supporting themselves with their left arm, while the right arm rests across their body holding a painter's palette and brush. They are gazing slightly downward. The background consists of a grid drawn over the composition, emphasizing the sketch's study nature.

artworks.title: Study of a Plaster Torso
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper, squared with graphite
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a seated figure with a draped cloth over its head and shoulders in a leaning pose with folded arms. It is a monochrome sketch featuring light and shadow to suggest a stone-like material. The figure is on a defined base or pedestal, partially enclosed or framed, creating a sense of intimacy or introspection.
